title: Loop-batch tests run the loop's real orphan-socket sweep against the host's tmux socket dir
summary: runLoopBatch calls gcOrphanSessions, which runs swarm.ExecReapOrphans and swarm.ExecReapOrphanSockets against the real tmux socket dir. A canary dead-pid socket file placed in /private/tmp/tmux-<uid>/ is removed by TestRunLoopBatch_GCHookFiresAfterFinalizeAtBatchEnd, TestRunLoopBatch_SignalExitSkipsBatchEndGCHook and TestC1735_002/003/006. Only sockets whose owning pid is dead are touched, so it is not destructive, but a unit test acts on host state; since dead sockets' files are now unlinked, the effect is visible. The evolve gc command tests were isolated with TMUX_TMPDIR in the gc PR.
fix: Give gcOrphanSessions an injected reaper seam (the loop config or a package var the loop tests stub), or set TMUX_TMPDIR in the loop tests' shared setup. A package-wide TMUX_TMPDIR is risky: tests that start real tmux can exceed macOS's 104-byte socket path limit under the long per-user temp dir.
acceptance: A canary socket file in the host's tmux dir survives `go test ./cmd/evolve/` (red today)
